question: Why does the joining and separating of infinite portions of beings become countless?
premises: Infinite portions of beings are joined and separated.
This occurs through connection with the non-difference of the prior state.
The prior non-differentiated ground prevents any fixed numerical limit.
inference: Therefore the combinations of manifested beings are countless because they arise from a non-differentiated ground.
uncertainties: upāśrite is read as expressing attainment in this context; morphology is compact.
plain_english: Here too, in the joining and separating of infinite portions of beings, countlessness is attained because of the connection with the non-difference of the prior state.
